evals.name: conversation-scoped-commit
evals.prompt: Você acabou de corrigir o refresh de token em src/auth.ts e tests/auth.test.ts. Agora faça commit disso. O repositório também tem uma alteração local não relacionada em README.md que pertence ao usuário.
evals.expected_output: Inspect the repository, commit only the recent auth implementation and its test with a Conventional Commit message, and leave README.md untouched.
expectations: The agent inspects the working tree before staging.
Exactly one commit contains src/auth.ts and tests/auth.test.ts.
The commit message follows Conventional Commits.
The agent reports that the unrelated README.md change was left untouched.

evals.name: whole-worktree-with-obsolete-sub-flag
evals.prompt: Faça commit --sub de tudo que está modificado. As alterações incluem uma correção de API com seu teste e uma atualização independente do guia de instalação.
evals.expected_output: Treat the request as a whole-worktree commit operation performed inline, split the independent code and documentation concerns, and create both commits sequentially without delegation.
expectations: The agent does not delegate, spawn a subagent, or describe --sub as a supported option.
The API fix and its test are committed together.
The independent installation guide update is committed separately.
The commits are staged, created, and verified sequentially.

evals.name: path-scope-conflicts-with-staging
evals.prompt: Faça commit somente de src/api/user.ts. package.json já está no stage por causa de outro trabalho meu; não inclua nem altere essa mudança.
evals.expected_output: Detect that the requested path scope conflicts with the existing staged state, preserve the user's staging exactly, and pause instead of creating a commit that includes unrelated work.
expectations: The agent inspects both working-tree and staged changes.
No commit is created while package.json remains staged outside the requested scope.
The agent does not unstage, reset, discard, or modify package.json.
The agent explains the staging conflict and asks the user how to proceed.
